#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <bitset>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

typedef bitset<128> u99;

const int mod = 1000000007;
const int inv = 570000004;
int add(int a, int b) { return (a + b < mod) ? a + b : a + b - mod; }
int sub(int a, int b) { return (a < b) ? a - b + mod : a - b; }
int mul(int a, int b) { return 1LL * a * b % mod; }

unordered_map<u99, int> name;
int n, dfn, son[65536][128];
int dfs(u99 s) {
	auto ite = name.find(s);
	if (ite != name.end()) return ite->second;
	int ret = dfn++;
	name[s] = ret;
	for (int i = 0; i != (1 << n); ++i) {
		u99 t = s;
		for (int j = 0; j != (1 << n); ++j) if (!t[j])
			for (int k = i & j; k; k ^= k & -k) if (s[j ^ k & -k]) {
				t[j] = 1;
				break;
			}
		son[ret][i] = dfs(t);
	}
	return ret;
}

int p[7][7], q[7][128], dp[8][65536];

int main() {
	cin >> n;
	dfs(1);
	for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) for (int j = 0; j != n; ++j) cin >> p[i][j], p[i][j] = mul(p[i][j], inv);
	for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) for (int j = 0; j != (1 << n); ++j) {
		q[i][j] = 1;
		for (int k = 0; k != n; ++k) q[i][j] = mul(q[i][j], j >> k & 1 ? p[k][i] : sub(1, p[k][i]));
	}
	dp[0][0] = 1;
	for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) for (int j = 0; j != dfn; ++j) for (int k = 0; k != (1 << n); ++k)
		dp[i + 1][son[j][k]] = add(dp[i + 1][son[j][k]], mul(dp[i][j], q[i][k]));
	u99 res;
	for (int i = 0; i != (1 << n); ++i) res[i] = 1;
	cout << dp[n][name[res]] << endl;
}
